Returns ControllerData::forceFeedback; StageTiming_InitForceFeedbackSlots creates effects only when set.
Stores ControllerData::quickForceUpdate and passes it to SetForceFeedbackDeviceValue (pad page item "Quick Force Update").
Stores a device's quick update flag, read by the effect setters to send changes at once or with DIEP_NODOWNLOAD.
Steering of an analogue device (Car::steeringInputMode != 0): the wheels' target from flag0x1d0[0..1] as 0..63 values, taken at once in mode 2 or eased by the setup's outward and centring rates.

Steering of keys and buttons (steeringInputMode 0, the else of AutoGear_UpdateCarGearState): an accumulator driven by the steering torque and the return rate, the wheels following it at a limited rate.
Digital brake (analogBrake 0): brakePhase rises by brakeRampStep while flag0x1d0[3] is held and brakeInput follows a sine of it; reset on release.
Digital throttle (analogThrottle 0): throttlePhase rises by throttleRampStep while flag0x1d0[2] is held and falls at twice the rate on release; throttleTorque follows a sine of it.
